evals.name: bootstrap-map-for-vague-reports
evals.prompt: 우리 웹앱 기능맵 좀 만들어줘. 운영팀에서 '사이드바에 뭐가 잘 안돼요', '입금 문구가 잘 입력이 안돼요' 이런 식으로 말하는데, 그때 AI가 바로 어디 코드인지 찾을 수 있으면 좋겠어.
evals.expected_output: A new docs/FEATURES.md following assets/feature-map-template-ko.md: header with the verified short SHA and date, a Premises line for facts common to every entry (e.g. no server), and a Note line when another FEATURES.md exists; a lookup protocol section first; a screen index mapping regions (e.g. the sidebar) to feature IDs; an alias index that keeps Korean/English and colloquial terms (입금, deposit, 충전, 입금 문구) marks collisions as (ambiguous), and records plausibly-requested but absent features as → 없음 rows; when the user's example features do not exist, the report says so instead of forcing a mapping; and per-feature entries with location, aliases, literal UI strings copied verbatim with i18n keys, controls with their handlers, a code path with only the hops that exist (persistent state with both write and read sites), tests (or explicit none), and pitfalls written as symptom → cause, each citing a commit or a `path` → `symbol` code source. Features are discovered from routes, layouts, nav config, and i18n files rather than the directory tree. Every path exists and every literal string greps in the source. The assistant adds a one-line lookup pointer to the project's root CLAUDE.md, creating it if missing, adds it to AGENTS.md when that exists, reports the change, and does not commit.

evals.name: update-mode-from-recorded-sha
evals.prompt: docs/FEATURES.md 만든 지 좀 됐는데 그 사이에 결제 화면이랑 알림 설정이 바뀌었어. 기능맵 최신화해줘.
evals.expected_output: The assistant reads the recorded SHA from the existing map's header (the only place the SHA lives) and runs git diff --name-status -M <sha>..HEAD; entries whose files appear in the diff are re-verified, renamed files get repointed paths, entries whose files were all deleted are dropped, and new routes/screens/UI strings become new entries. Entries that still verify are not rewritten. When most entries are suspect, the three step-6 checks run over the whole map and pitfall evidence is re-opened only where the cited file or commit is in the diff. If the recorded SHA is unreachable, it says so and re-verifies every entry rather than silently regenerating. The report lists entries added, changed, and removed, and the header SHA moves to HEAD.

evals.name: no-invented-pitfalls-and-split
evals.prompt: 기능이 40개 넘는 큰 프로젝트인데 기능맵 만들어줘. 자주 터지는 부분도 같이 적어줘.
evals.expected_output: Because the single-file map would pass ~500 lines, docs/FEATURES.md holds only the header, lookup protocol, screen and alias indexes, and an ID | purpose | file list, while entries move to docs/features/<screen>.md grouped one file per screen or route; entry files carry no Verified-at line. Pitfalls are written as symptom → cause and appear only where a fix commit (found by subject, then opened with git show) or a cited code statement (`path` → `symbol`) supports them; features without evidence say pitfalls: none rather than a plausible guess. Features without tests say tests: none.
